segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub awesome. It is time for GitHub trending weekly number 30. We have tracked down 35 trending
repositories on GitHub. Let's get into it.
3DS SVG turns any 2D SVG into an interactive 3D component in your browser. Drag in an SVG. Pick from 10
material presets like glass, chrome, or holographic. Add animations like floating or spinning. And export as a 4K
transparent PNG or 60fps MP4 using FFmpeg Wasom running entirely locally.
Hit embed and get a clean ReactJSX snippet using React 3 fiber ready to drop straight into your next.js project.
AI coding agents write great code but terrible visual documentation. Markdown viewer skills is a collection of 15
installable AI skills that teach your agent to use seven different rendering engines. Mermaid, plant UML, draw.io,
graph viz, and more. Enterprise cloud architectures, UI wireframes, dependency trees, even floor plans generated directly inside your markdown files.
Quinn bundles wois DNS records, mail server info, SSLTS certificate details and HTTP header text detection into a
single beautiful TUE. Ardap lookups first graceful voice fallback. Run subcomands like quen DNS or quen stack and get perfectly structured JSON.
Install it as a clawed code skill and your agents can run programmatic domain investigations without writing a single reject parser.
Fireworks tech graph is a clawed code skill that generates technical architecture diagrams from plain English. Type draw a multi-agent
collaboration diagram with an orchestrator and three sub aents in glass morphism style and it renders a professionalgrade visual straight into
your workspace preloaded with structural knowledge for rag pipelines, memories setups, agentic search and tool calling architectures.
iOS marketing capture is a clawed code skill that builds an automated screenshot system directly into your Swift UI project. So it has zero
footprint in production. Trigger it and it seeds your app with demo data and loops through all your supported local by relaunching under different language environments.
even captures isolated Swift UI elements like widgets with perfect transparency using image renderer.
Y Combinator CEO Gary Tan open sourced his personal AI knowledge system. Gbrain is long-term memory for AI agents.
Everything you know, people, companies, deals, meetings, stored as markdown files in a git repo. While you sleep, it scans your conversations, emails,
meeting transcripts, enriches entities, creates cross references, builds a knowledge graph. You wake up. Your digital brain got smarter overnight.
Bouncer is a browser extension that filters social media feeds by phrases, topics, or emojis, removing matching posts without breaking the scroll. The
bounce this post button is the clever part. Click it on any post that annoys you. A local AI analyzes it and suggests
three reasons why. Pick one and similar posts disappear permanently. The filter gets smarter every time you use it.
AI debuggers guess at fixes from static code and sometimes break something else in the process. Debug agent changes the
approach entirely. Install it as a clawed code or cursor skill. Run debug agent and instead of guessing, the AI
injects lightweight NDJSON logging and asks you to reproduce the bug. It analyzes live runtime logs to confirm or
reject hypothesis, only writes a fix when it has actual evidence, then verifies automatically.
If you run the Hermes AI agent, you need to see what it's actually thinking.
Hermes HUD brings a full consciousness monitor to your web browser. It reads directly from your agents local data directory, giving you real-time
visibility into memory vaults, active sessions, and loaded skills.
Per model token cost tracking so you can see exactly how much your autonomous agent is spending in real time.
Switching from Windows to Mac OS means leaving sevenzip behind and nothing on Mac has properly filled that gap. Shyzip
is a native Mac OS 7zip derivative built entirely in Swift and Objective C++. No Electron wrapper, no generic
crossplatform UI, full seven-zip format support, plus a custom Zstandard fork variant for modern fast compression running natively on Apple silicon.
Quip node manager is a cross-platform desktop guey built on Rust and Tori v2 that gives you a clean visual interface to configure, run and monitor your
nodes. Native or docker works on Mac OS, Linux and Windows out of the box.
Handles config, Toml files, secrets, binaries, and your trust database automatically. No cloud telemetry, no
SAS pipeline, just a window into your agent's actual state.
AI agents hallucinating facts from complex documents is a trust problem that breaks legal, financial, and
academic workflows. Light parse fixes the verification layer. Point your agent at a folder of documents and it
generates a structured HTML report where every extracted fact includes an interactive link that opens the source document and draws a bounding box around the exact text on the page.
Most terminal spinner libraries for Rust are bloated or require complex runtime integration.
Rattles takes a compile time first approach. All animation data, braille patterns, emoji, and asy presets baked directly into your binary at compile
time. No runtime, no life cycle management, no dependencies. Works in no environments out of the box. Drop it
straight into your Ratatouille render loop at zero cost.
Tired of massive bloated Python frameworks just to build an AI agent?
Helixcent is a lightweight TypeScript library built on bun for constructing React style agent loops. Reasoning, planning, executing, the core cognitive
loop of autonomous agents with none of the orchestration bloat. Raw minimal building blocks for custom agent loops,
LLM tool execution and CLI skills at maximum speed.
You merge a simple refactoring PR, publish the new version, and suddenly your GitHub issues are full of people saying you broke their code. TSNappy
fixes that by bringing snapshot testing to your public API contract. Every build generates two human readable snapshot
files, a snapshot.js for runtime exports and a snapshot d.ts for TypeScript declarations.
Local Azure development means juggling Azerite, the Cosmos DB emulator, functions core tools, and more. Minibil
replaces all of it with a single Docker command. 21 different Azure services running locally on one port. Blob storage, key vault, Cosmos DB, Azure
functions. All of it works with your existing Azure SDKs, Terraform, and Palumi setups. No Azure account, no network connection, no credit card.
Managing multiple clawed code sessions across T-Mux PES means constantly hunting for which agent needs attention.
T-Max agent sidebar adds a realtime sidebar that tracks the active status, prompts, git drift, and activity logs of every agent across all your T-M.
See which repos are active, which agents are waiting for input, and press enter to jump directly to any agents pane.
File Converter Pro is a fully offline Windows desktop app. documents, images, audio, video, all from one tool. Your files never leave your machine.
Multi-engine fallback so every conversion works. Auto detects Microsoft Office, Libri Office, FFmpeg for higher
quality output. Statistics dashboard, gamified achievements, rankup celebrations, confetti particles, seasonal overlays.
Carpathy's argument, rag is broken because it just retrieves the same raw chunks every time. His fix. Let an LLM
autonomously write and maintain a persistent markdown knowledge base. LLM wiki is the open source implementation.
Upload your PDFs, connect Claude via MCP, and it synthesizes encyclopedia style articles, flags contradictions,
and updates cross references across dozens of files simultaneously.
Most approaches feed raw SVG tokens straight into a language model. HiVG compresses them hierarchically instead.
Raw commands fold into atomic tokens.
Atomic tokens fold into learn segment tokens. 2.76 times shorter than what competitors feed their models. 3 billion
parameters. Beats GPT40 and Gemini 2.5 on image to SVG conversion. Give it a PNG. Get back an editable SVG. Give it a text prompt. Same deal.
Most Obsidian AI plugins let you chat with your notes. This one writes them.
Drop a source, an article, a PDF, a GitHub repo, and Claude reads it, extracts entities and concepts, cross references everything already in your
vault, and files it. No manual tagging, no folder decisions, and an eight category vault llinter that catches
orphan pages and dead links before they pile up. AI coding agents build functional UIs.
They rarely build beautiful ones. Styles Seed fixes that with 69 strict visual design rules, 48 components, and 11
installable AI skills. Shadows at 4% opacity, balanced typography ratios.
Pick a skin inspired by stripe, linear, or versel. Copy the engine files into your project. Your agent generates productionready interfaces that actually look intentional.
Standard image libraries crash Cloudflare workers. The memory limits are just too tight. SIP is a memory efficient image processing library built specifically for those constraints.
Resize, process, and optimize images with a microscopic memory footprint directly on the edge. No bouncing
payloads back to a heavy AWS backend just to crop a photo. Prep images for your AI vision agents right where the request lands.
Swift MTP is a native Mac OS utility built entirely in Swift UI. uses the colom backend from open MTP under the
hood but strips away all the web app bloat. Plug in your Android phone, it detects it automatically and you get a finder style interface with drag and
drop in both directions. Handles files over 4 gigs without freezing. Remotion lets you build videos in React.
What it doesn't ship with is a component library. So every fade, wipe, and kinetic title gets written from scratch.
Remoteen is a shad CN style registry that fixes that.
blur reveals, chromatic aberration wipes, a terminal simulator, a browser flow scene, a full product launch trailer composition, all tuned and ready
to edit. A fully functional VS Code instance in a single 25 megabyte npm package with zero dependencies.
Code packs the entire VS Code editor into a platform agnostic package you can run on any machine and access straight
from your browser. Spin up remote dev environments or embed an enterprisegrade code editor into your web app with almost zero overhead.
Giving an AI agent raw terminal access is a genuine security risk. Box is a sandboxed pix shell built on Dash
designed specifically to be driven by AI via a concurrent JSON line RPC protocol.
Linux namespace isolation traps every command in a secure sandbox so your agent can run builds, install packages, and execute scripts without touching
your host machine. Most hardware monitoring tools are locked to one OS or one GPU vendor. HBM works across NVIDIA,
AMD, and Intel GPUs on both Windows and Linux. It reads telemetry directly from low-level vendor APIs and renders core
temperatures, power draw, clock frequencies, PCIe traffic, and VRAM bandwidth in a retro asky visualization right in your terminal.
AI agents are great at JavaScript, but terrible at raw terminal commands. They hallucinate flags and crash your
environment. Clyjs fixes that by reading the help output of any binary on your system and converting it into a fully
typed JavaScript API. Subcomands become functions. Flags become object properties. Your agent calls structured
JS instead of piecing together fragile shell strings.
Mourer is a lightweight measurement and alignment overlay for React apps. Toggle it with a keyboard shortcut. Click elements to see exact bounding boxes.
Drop vertical and horizontal guides onto your page and hold alt to reveal pixel distances between components instantly.
full undo redo history and state persistence so your guides survive a page refresh.
Notebook LM will turn your docs into a podcast. You can't touch the script, the hosts, or the voices. This project gives
you all of that. Pointed at a URL, a PDF, a meeting transcript. Claude writes a two-host conversation script. Fish
audio generates the speech. FFmpeg stitches it into an MP3. Feed it your own writing, your resume, your browser
history, and ask the host to analyze you as if you're not in the room.
Recreating Apple's progressive blur headers in Swift UI is notoriously painful. Harsh cut offs, hard clipping,
gradient mask hacks. Progressive blur header solves it in one line of code. As content scrolls under your header, it
smoothly blurs with a flawless gradient, exactly like Apple Music, Photos, and the App Store. uses a private Apple API
under the hood to bypass standard Swift UI limitations.
Clean My Mac costs a yearly subscription, tracks your usage, and constantly upsells you. Pure Mac is the open- source alternative. MIT licensed,
runs entirely offline, zero analytics, clears system junk, Xcode derived data, homebrew caches, and APFS time machine
snapshots. Click to inspect shows exactly what gets deleted before you commit. Background automates the whole thing.
Most AI memory systems rely on massive vector databases and expensive embedding models. Hipatia takes a completely different approach named after the scholar of the library of Alexandria.
It's a lightweight memory system built entirely in Rust. SQLite FTS5 and duct DB tied together with a custom JSON
query language. No external models, no fuzzy vector embeddings.
Cyrite is a single skill file built on the entire methodology from Dr. Kristen Sanani's writing in the sciences course
at Stanford compressed into a machine actionable format. Drop it into your workspace and your AI becomes a
scientific editor. It flags passive voice, eliminates academic jargon, and explains exactly why a sentence is
clunky based on the Stanford methodology.
